revenue.definition: Financial Revenue derived from the canonical customer-paid Shift.revenue projection, which is recomputed from eligible completed-trip fares plus cancellation fees; blank/not-applicable cancellation fees are zero.
revenue.formula: sum(completedShift financial revenue after INCLUDED toll/parking treatment)

operatingCost.definition: Actual operating costs not already removed from Financial Revenue; INCLUDED toll/parking are pass-throughs and must not be deducted twice.

operatingProfit.definition: Financial Revenue remaining after actual non-pass-through operating costs.

availableCash.definition: Actual cash remaining after actual financing outflows recorded for the reporting period. Provisions are not deducted from this actual result.

provisionPlanning.definition: Planned amounts to reserve for future defined costs. These remain visible for planning and are not deducted from actual performance or available cash.

financingDetail.definition: Loan schedule and actual financing detail shown separately from operating profit and available cash.
financingDetail.rule: Amortization separates principal and interest. Scheduled obligation is informational; actual loan payments and applied prepayments affect available cash.

loanComponents.rule: Amortization separates principal and interest using actual days/365 interest; prepayment has zero prepayment charge. Principal reduces outstanding debt, interest is a financing cost, actual payment is a cash outflow, and no financing amount is deducted twice.

movementEconomics.rule: Vehicle KM is the denominator for Revenue/KM, Profit/KM, Cost/KM and vehicle-based break-even. Dead KM is reported separately for knowledge but remains included in vehicle KM.

unmodeledOtherBusinessCosts.rule: No unsupported other-business-cost amount is invented. A future authoritative input must be added before such costs enter the financial model.

fuelCostPerKm.rule: Full-tank-to-full-tank intervals only; first full-tank fill establishes baseline; partial fills are recorded but excluded; use latest 10 completed full-tank interval observations, and while the current interval is open use the previous completed observations.

maintenance.rule: exactly one dimension per maintenance item: KM or TIME; provision and actual invoice remain separate

currency.rule: safe integer paise at monetary boundaries

loan.rule: reducing-balance amortization with actual days/365 interest; prepayment has zero prepayment charge

goldenPolicy: Every changed financial formula requires a deterministic regression vector before deployment.
